import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    d = df.copy()

    # Normalize Region labels
    d["Region"] = d["Region"].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()

    # Normalize Category labels
    d["Category"] = d["Category"].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()

    # Parse Price values such as "$6.00" and "$180.00"
    d["Price"] = (
        d["Price"].astype(str)
        .str.replace(r"[\$,]", "", regex=True)
        .str.strip()
    )
    d["Price"] = pd.to_numeric(d["Price"], errors="coerce")

    # Quantity must be a positive whole number; treat negative signs as data-entry errors
    d["Quantity"] = pd.to_numeric(d["Quantity"], errors="coerce")
    d["Quantity"] = d["Quantity"].abs()

    # Recompute Revenue from corrected Quantity and Price
    d["Revenue"] = d["Quantity"] * d["Price"]

    return d

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=["Category"])
    totals = d.groupby("Category", dropna=True)["Revenue"].sum()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in totals.items()}
